settings.title: EV Charge Planner
settings.subtitle: Global settings for spot price charging
settings.pairing_auto_help: The app automatically creates an EV Ladeplan device on startup when none exists. CLI apps usually do not appear in the New Device search.
settings.create_device_help: Use this for a second car. The first device is created automatically.
settings.create_device_success: Device created: {{name}}. Find it under Devices.
settings.stromligning_api_key_help: Only needed as fallback when Energi Data Service is unavailable. Get your key at stromligning.dk.
settings.default_charge_hours_help: Used as default for new devices. Can be overridden per device in device settings.
settings.easee_section_help: Controls your Easee directly based on charge_now from the charge plan.
settings.easee_device_id_help: Find the ID under Developer Tools → Devices → Easee → ID.
settings.easee_circuit_current_help: Written to target_circuit_current when charge_now is true (typically 16A).
settings.easee_sync_power: Show real Easee power on EV Ladeplan tile
settings.easee_sync_power_help: measure_power on EV Ladeplan mirrors Easee instead of estimated 11 kW.
